items.title: Modern lighting control brings new life to historic basilica
items.summary: Pharos Architectural Controls has been installed to manage the floodlighting of the Sint-Petrusbasiliek in Oirschot, replacing an older system with a networked, energy-efficient control scheme suited to heritage facade lighting.

items.title: DLC Finalizes Networked Lighting Controls (NLC) V5.2
items.summary: DLC's Networked Lighting Controls V5.2 requirements take effect August 2026, tightening interoperability and reporting rules and extending NLC scope to integrated building systems such as HVAC, a change specifiers should track for future compliance.

items.title: House Passes Bill To Create Permanent Daylight Savings Time
items.summary: The US House passed a bill to make daylight saving time permanent, pending Senate approval; if enacted, it would affect astronomical time settings and scheduling logic in networked exterior and circadian lighting controls.

items.title: Trump Administration Declines To Renew USMCA Trade Deal
items.summary: The Trump administration will not renew USMCA in its current form, beginning a lengthy review process that could eventually affect component sourcing, tariffs and pricing for lighting manufacturers and specifiers in North America.

items.title: Foscarini – Asteria
items.summary: Foscarini's Asteria fixture, first shown at Euroluce 2025, reworks the multi-arm chandelier format with a pared-back, architectural profile suited to decorative specification.

items.title: Collingwood lights up Northampton Saints hospitality and net zero drive
items.summary: Collingwood Lighting has fitted new LED luminaires in the Barwell stand at Northampton Saints as phase one of a refurbishment aimed at improving stadium hospitality lighting and reducing energy use.
